description: Hand-authored short paraphrases of linked public institutional news releases; dates are release/event dates. Small curated English corpus, not a representative live-news benchmark. Relevance labels authored for this smoke evaluation; no independent annotators. Fixed clock for reproducibility.

articles.title: Artemis II crew launches aboard Orion
articles.content: NASA sent four astronauts toward the Moon on the Space Launch System for a crewed lunar flyby.

articles.title: Orion departs Earth orbit for lunar journey
articles.content: A translunar injection engine burn put Artemis II on its outbound trajectory toward the Moon.

articles.title: Artemis II astronauts demonstrate manual piloting
articles.content: The Orion crew practiced manual spacecraft control and prepared lunar flyby observations.

articles.title: Artemis II finishes lunar flyby
articles.content: The astronauts completed seven hours of lunar observations, photographing the far side.

articles.title: Crew sends lunar flyby photographs to Earth
articles.content: The Artemis II photographs show the Moon, Earth and a solar eclipse seen from Orion.

articles.title: NASA publishes Artemis II lunar science data
articles.content: The agency published lunar science reports, imagery and a data user guide for the crewed flyby.

articles.title: Artemis II crew returns to Houston
articles.content: Four astronauts were welcomed at Johnson Space Center after their ten-day journey around the Moon.

articles.title: DART spacecraft collides with Dimorphos
articles.content: NASA deliberately struck the moonlet of Didymos to test a planetary defense technique.

articles.title: DART collision changes asteroid orbit
articles.content: NASA confirmed that the impact altered Dimorphos's motion, demonstrating asteroid deflection.

articles.title: Webb observatory releases first science images
articles.content: The James Webb Space Telescope began scientific operations with infrared images and spectra of the cosmos.

articles.title: Euclid reveals first color views of the universe
articles.content: ESA's space telescope released its first full-color cosmic photographs, including galaxies in the Perseus cluster.

articles.title: WHO recommends R21 malaria vaccine
articles.content: R21/Matrix-M received a recommendation for preventing malaria in children.

articles.title: WHO prequalifies second malaria vaccine
articles.content: R21 became the second prequalified vaccine against malaria, following RTS,S.

articles.title: WHO declares mpox emergency
articles.content: The WHO Director-General classified the mpox outbreak as an international public health emergency.

articles.title: WHO prequalifies first mpox vaccine
articles.content: WHO prequalified MVA-BN after evaluating the vaccine for use against mpox.

articles.title: European AI Act comes into force
articles.content: The European Union adopted a legal framework governing artificial intelligence systems, with phased application.

articles.title: EU general-purpose AI model rules apply
articles.content: Providers of general-purpose AI models face obligations under the AI Act as the new rules take effect.
